name: XCC_CB_RULES_
description: This is the audit table for XCC_CB_RULES which stores the implemented control budget supplementary rules and revenue funding rules.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this transaction

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to XCC_CONTROL_BUDGETS table

columns.name: RULE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the supplemental or revenue funding rule.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description of the supplemental or revenue funding rule.

columns.name: CONTROL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Control level code used for supplemental rule. NONE is populated for REVENUE_FUNDING rule type.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: The % of the budgeted amount that will be used as tolerance

columns.name: TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The fixed amount that will be used as tolerance

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Business unit internal identifier

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this rule is enabled or not.

columns.name: ALLOW_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this rule can be updated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type of rule, valid values are SUPPLEMENTAL and REVENUE_FUNDING.

columns.name: REV_FUNDING_SOURCE_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Primary or secondary ledger identifier with the earned or collected revenue source amounts.

columns.name: MIN_REV_THRESHOLD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method used to determine the minimum revenue threshold amount. When a method is selected, revenue must be greater than the minimum revenue threshold amount before expense budgets can be funded by revenue.

columns.name: MIN_REV_BUDGET_SCENARIO
columns.description: GL budget scenario with the revenue estimate amounts used to determine the minimum revenue threshold amount.

columns.name: MIN_REV_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fixed minimum revenue threshold amount specified by the user.

columns.name: MAX_FUNDING_LIMIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method used to determine the maximum funding threshold amount. When a method is selected, the amount added to the expense budget from revenue can't exceed the maximum funding threshold amount.

columns.name: MAX_FUNDING_BUDGET_SCENARIO
columns.description: GL budget scenario with the revenue estimate amounts used to determine the maximum funding threshold amount.

columns.name: MAX_FUNDING_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fixed maximum funding threshold amount specified by the user.
